comment: Android's networks and Wi-Fi (AndroidNetworkBridge, RootWifi) for the Linux side's NetworkManager D-Bus service shared/platform/network-manager.py (rungic-plasma-network), over the independent hardware socket (RUNGIC_DEVICE_SOCKET; explicit legacy RUNGIC_PLATFORM_SOCKET, one JSON object per line each way, one request per connection; errors {"error": string}). network-get: version 1; every network row has the fields of the example (Wi-Fi rows may add ssid, bssid, mac, rssi, frequency, linkMbps, security), every route a destination and default (a gateway when it has one; a list's first example item is what every item has). wifi saved / scan-results: the text of Android's `cmd wifi list-networks` / `cmd wifi list-scan-results`, which the consumer parses line by line (SAVED_LINE, SCAN_LINE: the examples are that format). The changes (network-wifi, wifi scan/connect/activate/disconnect/forget) are Android's own and are authorized by the independent backend socket, without a foreground Activity; the provider check never sends them. The mobile data state the service also reads is the telephony contract's. Tested from both ends: tools/tests/test_contract_network.py (the real service, with a recording D-Bus connection, against tools/contracts.py's stand-in) and acceptance scenario contract.network (the Rungic app on the phone; names, addresses and the lists' text are blanked there).
